newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia govt sells interior design unit to staff.
newsitem.headline: Australia govt sells interior design unit to staff.

text.p: The Australian government said on Thursday it had sold its interior design unit, Interiors Australia, to a group of the firm's staff.

Interiors Australia, a business unit of the Administrative Services Department, offers services including strategic advice, accommodation planning, as well as design and supervision of office fitouts, Administrative Services Minister David Jull and Finance Minister John Fahey said in a joint statement.

"The government considers that the decision to sell to the employee buy-out group represents the most satisfactory outcome for the Commonwealth and is pleased that employees of the business will have an ongoing role in its management and operations," they said.
The government has been progressively selling business units of the department through a bidding process.
